title: Arrived scuffed up but fixable with paint pens
text: Arrived scuffed up but fixable with paint pens. Loved the look of this frame but was disappointed ted when it arrived scuffed up in all the raised parts which meant the white plastic underneath was showing.  After a little internal debate I decided to get brave and paint the design parts using rock painting paints I’d previously gotten.  The result is a fun frame that has a story all its own... the perfect display piece for our prized pictures.  Oh and don’t worry the glass/plastic photo covers are not broken, they’ve just shifted so aren’t sitting right.  Will be once we add photos.
